twoPointGrowth.note: Two sequential fixture sizes; compare exact before/after subjects and profiling flags, not an isolated causal slope.

limits: Scripted actor; no provider/coding productivity, causal clone allocation, speedup or release qualification claim.
Construction, calls, operator serialization, setup, custody and cold CLI phases stay separate; RSS includes retained allocations and GC effects.
Memory and counters describe this parent; child peak memory is not measured. Missing optional work counters remain unavailable, never inferred zero.

Raw absolute owner snapshots are retained after setup and before/after construction and SDK calls, outside timed phases and the CPU-profile interval. Existing phase delta collection is unchanged. Missing dynamic keys stay absent and first-appearing-key deltas stay null; no zero baseline is inferred. Exact owner implementation and named focused receipts govern any zero interpretation or binder-work claim.

Both matched calls are unprofiled. One optional after-only third 4 MiB call is separately profiled; its timing/counters are excluded from the matched pair. Actual close includes its successor; cold parity is scoped to the pair at that final prefix.
Budget checks occur at phase boundaries outside timed calls; aggregate 1 GiB is a monitored operational stop, not a filesystem quota, and may overshoot between checks.
Raw CLI requests live only in fixture-owned scratch and are cleaned by its existing hook; retained digests and actual cold outcomes/streams preserve the observed check.
Fixture setup materializes the already-packed artifact into disposable scratch through existing owners; immutable bootstrap install is not written.

Two full run_result and two bounded ordinal-page run_replay cold equalities are exercised at the final prefix; full typed terminal and same-operation owner outputs match. This is not whole-history replay qualification.
